head: 5d307b2df

scope.component: repair kernel contract and coverage suite

symptom: The complete Director Runtime suite is red after recent large-file splitting even though the exact-run audit, repair atomicity, precise-edit, and new TypeScript repair subsets are green.

other_signatures: coverage item cardinality changed and tuple unpacking now fails
some public repair paths return repair_not_planned where the contract expects an executable plan

root_cause.mechanism: Recent contract-test and runtime package splitting did not preserve every shared helper/fixture import and stale monkeypatch target. Once collection was restored, four production-semantic drifts remained: causal diagnostics were split across rows, coverage matched rules that their planner could not execute, a TypeScript narrow repair was hidden behind a broad type-position guard, and Rust enum E0063 coverage inspected unrelated source excerpts instead of the diagnostic headline.

repair_plan: Restore explicit imports or colocated fixtures for every split contract test; do not add compatibility shims in production code.
Re-run only the affected contract files and verify each missing symbol is eliminated before touching registry semantics.
Audit coverage overlaps as a separate behavior change; either make rule matching mutually exclusive or update a contract only when the new overlap is intentional and executable.
Re-run the complete 738-test suite before authorizing a fresh isolated bench verdict.
repairs_applied: Restored split-test helpers and fixtures in one test-only support module and restored the lost parametrize contract.
Updated monkeypatch targets to the post-split public execution owner rather than obsolete facade imports.
Preserved JavaScript constructor and Rust missing-library multi-line diagnostics as causal islands before per-line normalization.
Required TypeScript coverage to reflect planner-supported object-shape signatures and kept the narrow array-length assertion repair reachable.
Disambiguated Rust enum-variant E0063 from ordinary struct literals using the normalized diagnostic headline rather than unrelated raw source paths.
Updated Rust edit tests to enforce unique-context semantics without weakening ambiguous-edit fail-closed behavior.
stop_conditions: Do not rerun PM, Chief Engineer, or a generated project to diagnose this defect.
Do not weaken repair contracts or delete assertions merely to make the suite green.
Do not claim the Director Runtime platform is green until the complete suite exits 0.
